items.t: Automatic transmission shifts hard or fails
items.job: Replace valve body/solenoids or install remanufactured transmission
items.note: CarComplaints owners report $3,000-$4,800 on average for a failed transmission.

items.t: AWD angle gear wears out and leaks
items.job: Replace or rebuild AWD angle gear

items.t: AWD stops sending power to the rear wheels
items.job: Replace Haldex pump/controller and service AWD fluid
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,700 on average when more parts were replaced.

items.t: AWD system disabled warning (Haldex pump or coupling)
items.job: Replace Haldex pump and filter, change AWD fluid

items.t: Clogged PCV system pushes out oil seals
items.job: Replace PCV oil trap, hoses and intake gasket

items.t: ABS module fails and turns on warning lights
items.job: Repair or replace ABS control module
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $600 on average.

items.t: Central electronic module (CEM) faults
items.job: Repair or replace and program the CEM

items.t: Worn front control arm bushings
items.job: Replace front control arms or bushings and align

items.t: Turbo leaks oil onto the exhaust
items.job: Replace turbo oil lines and seals (or turbo)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $2,000 on average when the turbo was replaced.

items.t: Oil leaks from vacuum pump and valve cover
items.job: Reseal vacuum pump or valve cover

items.t: Hissing at idle from torn PCV diaphragm
Low oil level warning from faulty dipstick
items.job: Replace oil dipstick and update engine software

items.t: Engine burns oil from faulty piston rings
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (or install a replacement engine)
items.note: The lawsuit says a replacement engine costs more than $10,000.

items.t: Door won't lock or unlock with the remote
Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
Throttle body fault causes stalling and limp mode (recall)
items.job: Update software or replace electronic throttle module
items.note: The recall update is free; the old extended throttle warranty has ended.
